title: affaan-m/ECC
summary: ECC is an agent harness performance optimization system designed to enhance AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, and Cursor. It focuses on skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development to improve agent efficiency and reliability.
highlights: Optimizes agent harness performance across multiple AI coding tools
Emphasizes skills, instincts, memory, and security for robust agent behavior
Research-first development approach for continuous improvement
